CustomField.description: True when this group is only fanned out under a condition, mirroring Task_Group_Def__mdt.Conditional__c. Today the only conditional group is F, gated on Transaction__c.Loan_Required__c. Carried onto the record so the reconcile path can find conditional groups without re-reading the CMDT.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when this group only appears on deals that meet a condition, such as the loan group on financed deals.
CustomField.label: Is Conditional
